Subject: Keep more than 60 days of HitKeep data

Your Free plan keeps 60 days of data
====================================

Acme Analytics is receiving traffic from shop.example. On the Free plan, hits are retained for 60 days.

Upgrade to keep more history for trend comparisons, audits, and reporting.

See plans & upgrade: https://app.hitkeep.example/settings/billing

You can still export and review current data from the dashboard.
Open dashboard: https://app.hitkeep.example/dashboard
